ig_caption:
Your API was built for programmers. MCP is built for the model 🤖

API: endpoints. A programmer reads the docs, writes the code, handles the errors.
MCP: a menu for the agent. Each tool has a name, a plain-English description of when to use it, and the exact inputs.

The agent reads that menu at runtime and decides on its own.
MCP doesn't replace your API: most MCP servers simply wrap one. The difference is who it's written for.

Part 2/5 of MCP & Tools. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
